description:
Elixir: a variable that occurs twice in one pattern matches only equal values. fz ignores the repeat, and the last binding wins (planner bind, src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:937; bind_outcome_arguments, src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs:2150; apply_pattern and bind_pattern Var arms rebind).

Probe (scratch as/rep.fz versus rep.exs):
- `def same({x, x}), do: :same` plus a fallback clause, called as same({1, 2}): Elixir gives :diff, fz gives :same.
- `case {1, 2} do {y, y} -> :same; _ -> :diff end`: Elixir gives :diff, fz gives :same.
This is a silent wrong answer on every path.

fz-sc8.20's Both(p1, p2) makes it reachable across `=` (`{x, _} = {_, x}`).

Shape: the planner needs a subject-to-subject equality question. RegionQuestion::equality compares only against a Const or Pinned ComparisonValue today. The first occurrence binds; each later occurrence equates its subject with the first one's. The body-match apply_pattern does the same with an assert.

Not needed by the distiller; it sits at the end of the epic.
title: A variable repeated in one pattern requires equal values
